w: At 10.00am amidst Vedic chantings Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara.

After a four-hour flight, Swamishri landed in Nairobi at 6.00 pm. A welcome assembly was held in the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir. On the way to the mandir from the airport, Swamishri commented on the lack of greenery in the countryside. The driver informed Swamishri that the country was experiencing a drought. Swamishri prayed, “God will shower His grace. It will rain.”

Despite the heavy rains everywhere, Swamishri was eager to reach New Delhi for the final stages of preparation for the inauguration of Swaminarayan Akshardham. Swamishri left by car from Sarangpur at 4.05 pm and arrived at Bhavnagar airport at 6.00 pm. At 6.20 pm, Swamishri flew to New Delhi, arriving there at 8.20 pm.

At 6.00 pm 2100 dignitaries assembled in the mandir hall for a satsang assembly. Viveksagar Swami addressed them on the subject of true happiness. Thereafter Gnanvatsal Swami talked about the generation gap. A video on Swaminarayan Akshardham was shown. And finally Swamishri blessed the assembly by elaborating upon the boons given by God to man and the importance of satsang in life. Thereafter Swamishri personally blessed all the dignitaries.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
Darshansingh Sardar pilgrimaged 260 km by foot from Chandigadh to Akshardham. He covered the distance in five days, walking 120 km on the last day. Swamishri blessed him for his effort and faith.

At 10.00 Swamishri arrived at Edison mandir to celebrate the festival of Jal Jhilani Ekadashi. After Thakorji’s darshan and abhishek of Nilkanth Varni, Swamishri walked onto the main stage amidst the joyous applause of thousands of devotees. After the pujan rituals of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Swamishri steered a small boat on which Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was standing in a small makeshift pool of water. After performing five artis the head sadhus of each region spoke for a few minutes about the transforming effect of Swamishri’s stay in their centres. Thereafter senior sadhus and devotees garlanded Swamishri. Finally Swamishri blessed the festival assembly, “The festival celebrates the arrival of God after the monsoon rains fill the rivers and reservoirs with fresh, new water. He blesses all with divine joy and happiness. The jiva has to be purged of base instincts and faults. By taking refuge in God one’s ignorance and bad nature are dissolved. He liberates one from maya and blesses with brahmabhav (divinity). He brought the Gunatit Sadhu, whose association frees one from the bondage of mine-ness and infatuation for worldly objects.” At 12.20 pm Swamishri returned to East Brunswick. The next day Swamishri departed by flight from America at 9.35 am and landed at Farnborough airport at 9.10 pm (G.M.T). Swamishri arrived at the Neasden Mandir at 10.15 pm and briefly attended an assembly of devotees. Before retiring at 11.00 pm he blessed all the London sadhus for having fasted for 100 hours. Also, 241 devotees had observed fasts and other austerities.
